language.label: Language
language.description: Notai will display in your chosen language. Note content is never translated.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to your calm place to think.
auth.leftSubtitle: Your sticky notes, drawings, and lists are waiting on every device — synced the moment you sign in.
auth.bullet1: End-to-end synced across web, desktop & mobile
auth.bullet2: Works fully offline — even your first session
auth.bullet3: We never train on your notes
auth.termsConsent: By continuing you agree to the terms and privacy policy.

cookieConsent.bannerBody: We use essential cookies to make Notai work, and optional cookies for analytics. You can change this at any time from the footer.
cookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Required for sign-in, security, and to remember your preferences. Cannot be disabled.
cookieConsent.preferencesDesc: Stores your UI choices (theme, layout) on your device.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Helps us understand which features are used and where the app is slow.
cookieConsent.marketingDesc: Used to measure ad campaigns. We do not currently use any.

footer.tagline: A calm, local-first notes app with sticky windows, drawings, and optional cloud sync. Made with care in Romania.
footer.copyright: © {year} Notai · Operated by Vlăduțescu Dragoș Cătălin (PFA), Romania.

hero.badge: New · Sticky notes that float on top of your desktop
hero.description: Write, draw, and sketch in one beautifully unhurried space. Pin sticky notes on top of every window. Everything syncs in realtime — even when you go offline.

bento.title: A notebook that finally keeps up.
bento.subtitle: Words, drawings, lists, sticky notes — all in the same calm space, all synced everywhere you work.

draw.title: Sketch ideas the moment they show up.
draw.text: Pressure-sensitive strokes, palm rejection, and a canvas that stays out of your way until you need it.

sticky.title: Sticky notes that float above every window.
sticky.text: Install the desktop app and pin notes that stay visible while you work in any other app.

sync.title: Your notes, on every device — instantly.
sync.text: Type on your laptop, keep editing on your phone. Cursors, selections, edits — all live.

offlineFirst.title: Offline-first
offlineFirst.text: Keep writing on planes, in tunnels, anywhere. Changes sync the moment you reconnect.

speed.title: Made for speed
speed.text: Local-first storage, instant search, no spinners. Your thoughts shouldn't wait.

keyboard.title: Keyboard-first
keyboard.tryPrefix: A command palette for everything. Try

useCases.eyebrow: Built for the way you actually work
useCases.title: Quiet, fast, and out of your way.

makers.quote: "The canvas + checklists combo is what I always wanted. I plan, sketch, and ship from one spot."

finalCta.offlineNote: Works online & offline from day one

features.metaDescription: Everything Notai does — sticky notes that float on top, drawings, AI search, real-time sync, daily notes, graph view, public pages, and a public REST API.
features.title: Every feature, organized by how you actually use them.
features.subtitle: Notai is one app split into four moments: capture, find, sync, daily flow. Pick a section below — or just scroll.
features.readyText: Free forever for personal use. No credit card. Works offline.

capture.title: Capture
capture.subtitle: Get the thought out of your head before it disappears.

pin.title: Sticky notes that float on top
pin.body: Tiny windows that pin themselves above every other app. Perfect for snippets, todos, or the one thing you must remember during a call.

draw.title: Draw, write, and type in one canvas
draw.body: Powered by Excalidraw. Sketch a wireframe, write a paragraph, drop an image — there is no mode you have to pick first.

quick.title: Quick capture, anywhere
quick.body: Cmd / Ctrl + Shift + N from anywhere on your desktop drops a fresh sticky note. Voice-to-note works too.

smartPaste.title: Smart paste
smartPaste.body: Paste a URL or transcript and Notai extracts the key points, tags, and a title for you.

find.title: Find
find.subtitle: Notes are useless if you cannot find them.

palette.title: Command palette (Ctrl + K)
palette.body: Jump to any note, run any command, open any setting — never break flow with the mouse.

ask.title: Ask my notes
ask.body: Semantic search + AI synthesis with citations. Stream answers in seconds, with links back to the source notes.

graph.title: Graph view
graph.body: See how notes link to each other. Click a node to jump in. Great for spotting orphans and rediscovering old ideas.

tags.title: Tags, folders, and backlinks
tags.body: Use whichever organization feels right today. [[wiki-style]] links plus tag pages plus folders — never just one.

sync.title: Sync
sync.subtitle: Local-first with optional cloud — never the other way around.

offline.title: Works offline from day one
offline.body: Every change is local-first via Y.js CRDTs. When you reconnect, your edits and your collaborators' edits merge cleanly.

collab.title: Real-time collaboration
collab.body: Share a note or a folder. Multiple cursors, presence, and zero merge conflicts. Powered by Hocuspocus on EU servers.

public.title: Public pages
public.body: Publish any note as a beautiful read-only page at notai.ro/u/yourhandle. Share a link, no account required for readers.

eu.title: EU hosting, no AI training
eu.body: Stored in europe-west1. We never train AI on your notes, never sell your data, and never run analytics inside your notes.

dailyFlow.title: Daily flow
dailyFlow.subtitle: Built for ADHD and creative brains.

today.title: Today's note
today.body: A note that creates itself every morning. Open it with Ctrl+J. Write whatever — Notai will offer a gentle daily review at the end of the day.

pinned.title: Pinned notes & version history
pinned.body: Pin the few notes that matter; everything else stays out of the way. Every save is a version you can roll back to.

kbd.title: Keyboard-first, mouse-optional
kbd.body: Press ? anywhere for the live cheatsheet. The whole app can be driven from the keyboard.

export.title: Bulk export to Markdown
export.body: Settings → Export your notes downloads a ZIP of every note. Your data is yours, always.

developers.title: For developers
developers.subtitle: Build on top of your own notes.

rest.title: Public REST API
rest.body: Read and write notes with personal access tokens. OpenAPI spec at /api/v1/openapi.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: Subscribe to note.created, note.updated, and more. Signed with HMAC-SHA256, retried with backoff, replayable from the dashboard.
